problem: Safe relative artifact refs rejected a Windows drive colon only in the first segment, while nested ADS refs and Windows alias/device names remained accepted.
cause: Path validation modeled POSIX traversal plus a first-segment drive check, but import materializes each segment through Windows filesystem semantics.
rule: When a contract promises safe relative refs on Windows, validate every segment before filesystem use: reject colons/ADS, trailing dot or space aliases, and reserved device stems case-insensitively; preserve valid nested paths.
applies_to: Windows artifact imports, archive extraction, content-addressed bundles, atomic staging paths
